name: brainstormer-codex
description: Read shared content and organize work across the Brainstormer sessions your connected account can access.

interface.shortDescription: Choose and organize accessible Brainstormer sessions through one connection.
interface.longDescription: Brainstormer Codex uses one account-level OAuth connection to discover sessions the user can currently access. Every content call targets an exact session UUID and rechecks the user's live role. Users choose read-only or read/write access during approval. Private Spaces and their linked content are never included.
defaultPrompt: List my accessible Brainstormer sessions and ask which one to use.
Turn the previous answer into separate Brainstormer nodes.
Help me create or update Brainstormer tasks.
